text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet, victorious on the grand 
stage of the Tenno Sho (Autumn)――

She realized that the "Number One" she 
aimed to be was an Umamusume who would 
forever live on in everyone's memories.

Her next goal is the Arima Kinen. Daiwa 
Scarlet made a firm vow to become the 
"Number One" Umamusume there as well.
